text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa put on a brilliant run. 
However—the spectators and reporters all 
chatted about the Oaks instead.

That conversation reached Nakayama Festa's 
ears as well. She painfully realized that 
fighting hard in the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby) wasn't enough to become 
the symbol of hope she wanted to be.

"How could I ever make anyone's eyes 
sparkle if I stay the way I am?" Fired up, 
she vowed to demonstrate absolute 
dominance at the "Kikuka Sho."
—Before the illness snuffs out all hope.
